2. On 07.06.2022 at 08:40 hours, the dead bodies of Mst. Sakeena wife of Muhammad Yousaf aged about 65/66 years and her daughter Mst. Sadaf aged 22l23years residents of Kot Banda were brought to civit hospital Banda Daud Shah, where Zafar Ali Khan, brother of deceased Mst. Sakeena, apprised the police that on 07.06.2022 in the morning, he visited the house of his sister Mst. Sakeena where he along with both the deceased were present in the house. Meanwhile, at about 08:00 hours, accused v Zeeshan and Farooq sons of Mumtaz duly armed with fire-arm "Aslaha Atesheen" criminally trespassed into the house and launched a murderous assault by firing upon them with intent to kill them, resultantly, his sister Mst. Sakeena and niece Mst Sadaf got hit and died on the spot while complainant escaped unhurt luckily. The incident happened in his presence while dispute over market served as motive for the crime. The above report of complainant was reduced into writing vide murasila followed by the F.I.R.

3. After completion of investigation, challan was submitted for trial. At the trial, prosecution in support of its case examined as many as 11 witnesses. After completion of prosecution evidence in the case, accused was examined undet section 342 Cr.P.C, however, neither he opted to be examined as his own witness nor wished to produce defence evidence. After hearing arguments, the learned trial Court vide impugned judgment dated 25.01.2024,the appellant was held guilty for the commission of the offence, sentenced him as follows:i. u/s 302(by34 P.P.C the convict Umar Farooq was found pilty for commttting Qatl-e'amd of Mst.

4. The present appellant being aggrieved of conviction and sentence, has filed the instant criminal appeal No.21-B/2024, while aggrieved there from the quantum of sentence in the instant criminal appeal, the complainant Zafar Ali Khan has preferred Cr.R No.08-B/2024 [Zafor Ali Khan v. Muhammad Farooqlfor enhancement of the same. As both the matters have arisen out of one and the same judgment, so we intend to decide the same through this common judgment.
5. We have heard learned counsel for the parties alongwith learned A.A.G for the State at length and perused the record in the light of arguments so addressed.

6. Although the learned trial court applied its judicial mind to the facts and circumstances of the case, yet this Court is to see as to whether the approach of the learned trial court was correct and f {"

in accordance with law; whether the learned Judge appreciated the available record and the statements of the witnesses; whether the impugred judgment is based on the collected material and recorded statements. As in the incident there is sole eye-witress, i.e, the complainant Zafar Ali Khan (PW-10) of the c.Ne and to convict the accused charged on the strength of the statement of solitary witress exta-ordinary care and caution is required. True, t}tat determining factor is not the quantity of witresses, but the quality; hence, this Court is to see as to whether the complainant could establish his presence on the spot at the stated time. In order to avoid miscarriage ofjustice, we deem it necessary to revisit and reappraise the already appreciated evidence.

7. The moot questions for determination before tJris Court are, as to whetler the complainant was present with the deceased at the stated time; as to whether the complainant could convince the judicial mind of the court regarding the marurer in which the incident occurred; as to whether tlte complainant was deposing against the appellant with malice in mind and as to whether the incident occurred in the mode and manner and at the stated time. In order to appreciate the material aspect of the case, we deem it essential to go through the statement of the complainant which he recorded before the learned trial court.

10. In this case, the alleged incident had taken place on 07.06.2022 at about 08:00 hours and the matter was reported at 08:40 hours. It was in the first report recorded from the mouth of complainant Zafar Ali Khan (PW-10) on 05.10.2023. His statement has been reproduced above. It is evident from the statement of PW-10 that Mst. Sakeena is his sister and Mst. Sadaf was his niece who were the residents of Kot Banda while complainant who is brother of deceased Mst. Sakeena is resident of another village Shahida Banda. The alleged incident no doubt has taken place inside the house and there are kind of witnesses where their presence is proved because of the incident to have lb dn - lt been happened inside the house or, otherwise, if any other witness was injured, as the incident has taken place inside the house, these are called natural witnesses. No doubt, the two deceased were the resident of same house in village Kot Banda, but the complainant who is the brother of Mst. Sakeena and the maternal uncle of Mst. Sadaf deceased is hailing from another village Shahida Banda. In this case, the happening occurred, no doubt in the month of July, in eady hours of the moming, i.e, 08:00 hours. Now the first thing which is to be seen in the instant case and that is to be considered that what were the circumstances that brought the complainant (PW-10) to the house of his deceased sister in the early hours of the moming. Has there was a special occasion in the house of his sister certainly the answer is a big "No", as nothing has been brought or explained by the complainant (PW-10) to explain the circumstances which prompted him to visit the house of his deceased sister.

Therefore, in view of the above, it is held that the incident has gone un-witress and that Zafar Ni Khan complainant @W-10)

Regarding the medical evidence, the lady doctor (PW-l), has found almost all the entry wounds on both the deceased (mother and daughter) were of the same size and dimension, which other-wise, reflects that it was the job of one weapon and single person.
